description: This script sets up a Git repository and performs tests related to blaming lines in a file through its history using topic branches. It includes test setup commands, Git operations, and assertions for expected behavior.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified changes to a file or repository state.

methods.name: test_merge
methods.description: Merges branches or commits as part of the test setup.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test expecting success with a specific description.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual and expected output or data.
